# INHERIT — Open Estate Data Interchange Standard

> JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 standard for structured estate planning data. 33 entity schemas, 21 jurisdiction extensions, SDKs in 5 languages, Go CLI. Apache 2.0 licence.

## Quick start
- AI Integration Guide: docs/implement/ai-guide.md
- Examples: examples/ (TypeScript, Python, Go code + 34 JSON fixtures)
- Schemas: v3/ (all JSON Schema 2020-12 files with rich descriptions)
- OpenAPI: openapi/openapi-bundled.yaml (fully dereferenced)
- Reference data: reference-data/ (enum descriptions, agent task definitions)

## Rules for AI agents
1. All monetary amounts are integer minor units (pennies/cents)
2. All IDs are v4 UUIDs
3. All dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)
4. unevaluatedProperties: false — no undeclared fields
5. British English throughout
6. Do NOT modify schemas in v3/ without a formal proposal
7. Always validate output with AJV or the CLI — never self-validate

- Developer docs: https://dev.openinherit.org
